name: CashyAi
shortDescription: Track spending, split bills with friends, and ask an on-device AI before you spend — private by design.
description: CashyAi is an Android expense tracker that helps you log income and spending, plan savings goals, split bills with friends, and get bill reminders. A local, on-device AI (no cloud calls for your financial data) answers questions like "Can I afford this?" using your own transaction history. An optional Google Drive backup keeps a copy of your data in a private folder tied to your account, so you can restore it on a new device.

screenshots.alt: CashyAi dashboard showing monthly cash flow, income, expenses, and upcoming bills

features: Expense, income, and bill tracking with reminders
Split expenses with friends and a running contact ledger
Savings goals and a safe-to-spend daily limit
On-device AI chat for spending questions — no financial data leaves the device
PDF and CSV export of your own records
Optional Google Drive backup and restore

googleSignIn.purpose: CashyAi uses Google Sign-In for exactly one feature: backing up your app data to your own Google Drive and restoring it later, for example after switching devices. Sign-in is optional — the app is fully usable without it, and no Google account is required to track expenses, split bills, or use the AI chat.

scopes.reason: Shown in Settings so you can see which Google account a backup is signed in with. Not used for advertising, analytics, or any purpose beyond identifying the signed-in account.

Lets the app read and write only its own hidden application-data folder in your Drive — the same folder other apps' Drive backups cannot see. CashyAi cannot see, list, or modify any other file in your Google Drive with this scope.

googleSignIn.dataNotAccessed: CashyAi never requests access to your Gmail, contacts, calendar, general Drive files, or any other Google data.
